svg.title: Agentic orbit - AI-driven development and certifications
svg.desc: AI-driven development: Claude Code at the centre, with MCP rings connecting agents to codebases, tools and data, and GitHub Copilot in the loop. Certifications: Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol and Claude 101 (Anthropic, Aug 2026); Microsoft AZ-204 Azure Developer Associate, AI-900 Azure AI Fundamentals, AZ-900 Azure Fundamentals.
svg.text: MCP servers connect agents to codebases, tools and data across design, coding, testing and review.
